text.tspan: (A) Symptomatic case infects individual, who is traced and
(B) Symptomatic case infects individual, who is traced and
(C) Symptomatic case infects individual, who is quarantined
(D) Symptomatic case infects individual, who is missed by
contact tracing and isolates a delay after symptom onset
(E) Asymptomatic case infects individual, who isolates a delay
(F) Symptomatic case infects individual, who isolates before
